bill_context_label: S.2, the Secure America Act, which adds about $70 billion for border, immigration enforcement and investigation agencies, available until September 30, 2029
bill_description: The bill would give about $70 billion more to federal agencies, in addition to money they already have. The money could be used until September 30, 2029. It would go mainly to two agencies in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). Customs and Border Protection (CBP) guards the borders and includes the Border Patrol. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrests, holds and deports noncitizens. Some money would go to Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), the part of ICE that investigates crimes, for work other than immigration and customs enforcement. The bill would pay for officers and staff, detention and deportation operations, border technology, and other enforcement work.
